note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our cloud hosting contract renews next month at $240,000 a year. We want to know whether to renegotiate or switch.

answers.common.decision: Renegotiate or switch; the head of procurement decides.
answers.common.audience: The head of procurement and the CTO.
answers.common.materials: A competitor quoted $198,000 a year for the same capacity. Our contract allows a 5% annual price increase. Migration would cost about $60,000 one time.
answers.legal-contracts-procurement.documents: The hosting agreement and the competitor quote.
answers.legal-contracts-procurement.reviewer: Our general counsel reviews contract changes.
